stem: Meena adds a few drops of red food colouring to two identical glasses of water, one with cold water and one with hot water, without stirring either glass. Which statement about what she observes is correct?

options.text: The colour spreads only after Meena stirs the water with a spoon.
The colour spreads faster in the hot water because water particles move faster at higher temperature.
The colour spreads at the same rate in both glasses because water particles do not move.
The colour spreads faster in the cold water because cold water particles move faster.

teacher.key_rationale: Colour spreads through water because water particles are in constant motion (diffusion); hotter water has faster-moving particles, so the colour spreads faster in the hot glass. Stirring is not required.
